top_authentic_signals.name: Audio Track
top_authentic_signals.summary: Embedded video audio: This audio appears to be authentic human speech. Confidence: 100%. Inference via local wav2vec2.
top_authentic_signals.what_found: The model classified this audio as a authentic human voice with 100% directional confidence. Probability real: 100% | Probability fake: 0%.
top_authentic_signals.why_it_matters: AI voice cloning is increasingly used to fabricate statements by public figures. This check catches spectral artifacts in the audio that TTS models leave behind.
top_authentic_signals.caveat: The model was fine-tuned on 6 TTS engines. Novel cloning systems not in its training set may evade detection. Short clips (<2.5 s) or heavily compressed audio may reduce accuracy.

top_authentic_signals.name: Embedded Audio Micro-Signature
top_authentic_signals.summary: The voice shows natural micro-variation (jitter 1.69%, shimmer 13.92%), consistent with real vocal-fold behaviour.
top_authentic_signals.what_found: The voice shows natural micro-variation (jitter 1.69%, shimmer 13.92%), consistent with real vocal-fold behaviour.
top_authentic_signals.why_it_matters: Real vocal folds never repeat a cycle perfectly. Text-to-speech and voice clones tend to be smoother and more regular, so this measured signature is hard for a generator to fake without modelling true vocal physics.
top_authentic_signals.caveat: Heavy compression, noise reduction, and short or noisy clips can distort these measurements, so this is weighed with the other audio signals.

top_ai_signals.name: Metadata & Provenance
top_ai_signals.summary: The file's embedded provenance marks it as AI-generated.
top_ai_signals.what_found: The provenance metadata flags this as trained-algorithmic (AI-generated) media.
top_ai_signals.why_it_matters: Provenance markers like C2PA are an industry-standard, hard-to-fake trace written by the generator itself. Finding one is among the strongest provenance signals available.
top_ai_signals.caveat: Provenance can be stripped or, rarely, forged. Absence of a marker is not proof of authenticity.

top_ai_signals.name: Spectral Artifacts
top_ai_signals.summary: The Six-Lens model scored this image 95.1% AI / 4.9% authentic — a extremely high-confidence finding toward synthetic generation.
top_ai_signals.what_found: All six spectral lenses — visual texture (ConvNeXt), frequency grids (FFT), sensor noise simulation (SRM), color-space fingerprints (YCbCr), spatial reconstruction (SPAI), and robustness testing — collectively scored this image 95.1% AI. A score this strong, the majority of lenses independently flagged patterns like periodic frequency grids and noise distributions inconsistent with any known camera sensor profile.
top_ai_signals.why_it_matters: This model looks for patterns invisible to the human eye — buried in the pixel-level math of the image. A 95.1% score means the statistical fingerprint aligns significantly more with AI generation than camera physics, and these frequency-domain traces are very hard to remove without visibly degrading the image.
top_ai_signals.caveat: Heavy JPEG compression, aggressive resizing, or strong image filters can partially destroy the frequency-domain signals this model depends on, potentially softening a confident AI detection into an inconclusive result. Conversely, very new or unusual AI generators not present in training data may produce lower-than-expected scores.

top_inconclusive_signals.name: Error Level Analysis (ELA)
top_inconclusive_signals.summary: The ELA map shows moderate, fairly uniform compression residuals (mean: 1.14, quadrant spread: 0.62). No editing seams or compositing artifacts were detected.
top_inconclusive_signals.what_found: Re-saving at quality 90 produced a mean residual of 1.14 with a quadrant spread of only 0.62. The compression stress is consistent across all four quadrants, and only 0.00% of pixels show elevated residuals. This uniform profile suggests the image has a consistent compression history - no obvious signs of region-level editing or compositing.
top_inconclusive_signals.why_it_matters: A uniform ELA profile removes one red flag - there are no obvious editing seams. However, ELA does not tell us whether the image is AI-generated, only that it has not been obviously composited. The other detectors handle the AI vs. real question.
top_inconclusive_signals.caveat: ELA detects editing and compression inconsistency, not AI generation. Social media uploads, repeated saves, and WhatsApp forwarding all degrade this test. It's treated as a weak supporting check.
